description: The Klöntalersee lies in the Klöntal, inside the municipality of Glarus, with the Glärnisch wall along its southern shore and the hamlets of Vorauen and Seerüti on the water. The eastern dam belongs to the standing lake, and no extra village is added on the cliffs. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and breezy, with no rain.
